name: spacial-shell
title: SpacialShell
description: Control the SpacialShell tiling window manager: switch workspaces, move windows, cycle layouts.
author: alice

commands.name: switch
commands.title: Switch to Workspace…
commands.description: Pick a workspace on any display and switch to it

commands.name: cycle-layout
commands.title: Cycle Workspace Layout
commands.description: Switch the active workspace to its next layout

commands.name: focus-workspace-up
commands.title: Switch to Workspace Above
commands.description: Switch to the workspace above the current one

commands.name: focus-workspace-down
commands.title: Switch to Workspace Below
commands.description: Switch to the workspace below the current one

commands.name: focus-window-left
commands.title: Focus Window to the Left
commands.description: Focus the tab to the left of the current window

commands.name: focus-window-right
commands.title: Focus Window to the Right
commands.description: Focus the tab to the right of the current window

commands.name: move-window-up
commands.title: Move Window to Workspace Above
commands.description: Send the focused window to the workspace above

commands.name: move-window-down
commands.title: Move Window to Workspace Below
commands.description: Send the focused window to the workspace below (a new one if it's the last)

commands.name: move-window-left
commands.title: Move Window One Tab Left
commands.description: Swap the focused window with its neighbour on the left

commands.name: move-window-right
commands.title: Move Window One Tab Right
commands.description: Swap the focused window with its neighbour on the right

commands.name: toggle-float
commands.title: Float or Re-tile Window
commands.description: Float the focused window, or put a floating one back in the tiling

commands.name: reload
commands.title: Reload SpacialShell
commands.description: Quit SpacialShell, putting every window back on screen, and start it again

preferences.name: spacialctl
preferences.title: spacialctl Path
preferences.description: Override the path to the spacialctl binary
